articles.summary: Fluor Corporation (NYSE: FLR) and its joint venture partner, Balfour Beatty, joined the Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT), local officials and community stakeholders yesterday to celebrate the opening of the Oak Hill Parkway project in southwest Austin, Texas. The milestone marks the delivery of a major transportation improvement project that enhances mobility, safety and connectivity along one of the region’s most heavily traveled corridors. Dignitaries celebrate the opening of the Oak Hill Parkway in Austin, Texas The $677 million Oak Hill Parkway project, part of TxDOT’s Clear Lanes initiative, reconstructed and widened approximately seven miles of U.S. 290 and SH 71 through Oak Hill from two to three mainlanes in each direction. articles.title: Fluor Joint Venture Celebrates Opening of Oak Hill Parkway in Austin, Texas
